mechanism: Paroxetine inhibits CYP2D6, reducing perphenazine metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations; additive anticholinergic and CNS depressant effects also occur.
action: Monitor for increased perphenazine adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, anticholinergic effects); consider dose reduction of perphenazine or alternative antipsychotic with lower CYP2D6 metabolism.
